description:
-= Basement =-
You are in a basement. A normal kind of place.



There is an unblocked exit to the east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked.
inventory: You are carrying: a rectangular key.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, try to take a trip east. And then, lift the nest of insects from the floor of the parlor. Got that? Good!
